item.title: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold
item.description: Dismissals follow probe that uncovered illegal oil refineries and smuggling in a region run by Kataib Hezbollah.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza
item.description: Hamas confirms the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis on Saturday.

item.title: Iran war live: Israel vows Gaza ‘offensive policy’ despite caretaker status
item.description: Israel has pledged to continue its 'offensive policy' on Gaza, as fighting in Yemen grips the region.

item.title: Deadly car bomb blast kills two near Syria’s capital
item.description: At least two people, a man and a girl, have been killed in a car bomb blast in Jaramana, near Syria's capital Damascus.

item.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
item.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
